scenarios.scenario: Surface — Extract build errors from a large multi-target failure
scenarios.reasoning: The agent did a good job overall despite encountering path resolution issues early on. It recovered well, identified the correct file, and extracted meaningful summary information including error codes, counts, failing projects, and target frameworks. The main gap is failing to identify that errors are concentrated in HotReload test files — the agent couldn't read the large temp files containing detailed error listings and didn't find an alternative way to examine them. The approach was reasonably efficient with 11 tool calls despite the initial path issues.

rubricScores.criterion: Identified that the build failed with F# compiler errors (FS0039 / FS0072 dominate)
Reported the scale: ~167 distinct errors (170 occurrences), not just the first handful
Named the failing project(s): FSharp.Compiler.ComponentTests (and FSharp.Compiler.Service.Tests)
Noted the two target frameworks involved (net10.0 and net472)
Observed the errors are concentrated in the new HotReload test files
